subject.title: Feature request: session:reset hook event for memory persistence on auto-resets

question: Should automatic daily and idle rollovers extend the existing reset contract through a dedicated typed session-reset event, or should they reuse command-style reset events for internal hooks?
rationale: The primary behavior requires a stable shared lifecycle API affecting bundled and custom hooks; current code provides only command events for session-memory while the open implementation uses a different event shape.

options.title: Add a typed reset lifecycle event
options.body: Expose a reasoned reset event with prior-session context for automatic and manual resets, then migrate bundled session-memory to it while preserving existing command compatibility.

options.title: Reuse command-style reset events
options.body: Dispatch the existing internal command surface for automatic daily and idle rollover, minimizing new event types but coupling lifecycle transitions to command semantics.

options.title: Limit the change to plugin hooks
options.body: Extend `before_reset` for automatic rollovers but leave managed and workspace internal hooks unchanged, which does not fully meet the bundled session-memory use case.

recommendation.title: Add a typed reset lifecycle event
recommendation.body: Expose a reasoned reset event with prior-session context for automatic and manual resets, then migrate bundled session-memory to it while preserving existing command compatibility.

likelyOwner.reason: The relevant code and the overlapping proposal both converge on the hooks/plugins boundary.
